resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS, firelookout.com and the Weebly summary give 1955, but a 1949 Eugene Guard item quoted on the Weebly page mentions slides from Rebel Rock lookout. The records do not explain whether an earlier structure stood on the site; the story uses 1955 and flags the 1949 reference.

sources.title: Forest Fire Lookout Association Oregon Chapter report, 2017

notes_for_editor: WebSearch was unavailable for this run (the shared search budget was spent before this tower), so nothing about the site today was checked beyond the pages read. The 1949 slide reference conflicts with the 1955 build date and nothing read explains it; a Forest Service or Eugene Guard source would settle it. The FFLOS table does list 'Removed 2017', the same year as the fire, so no separate removed event is recorded; the 2017 burned event covers it. The brief's access is unknown, and the story makes no access claim.
